verdict.rationale: Shortwave is a SaaS email client, so an official MCP server that lets external agents reach a user's mailbox is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows Shortwave acting as an MCP client: its AI Assistant can be pointed at outside MCP servers via "Add custom integration". That is the opposite role and earns no credit here. No first-party Shortwave MCP server or endpoint is documented, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
